defs.def: conversations in a book, play, or film/movie （书、戏剧或电影中的）对话，对白

ex.s: It has a plot, settings, characters and actions, as well as dialogue between characters.
ex.t: 它有情节、场景、人物和动作，以及人物之间的对话。

ex.s: When the silent era ended in 1929, Chaplin continued to make films, but these films had little or no dialogue.
ex.t: 当1929年无声电影时代结束时，卓别林继续拍电影，但这些电影几乎没有对白。

ex.s: Then listen to the dialogue and complete it by underlining the words or expressions you hear.
ex.t: 然后听对话，在听到的单词或表达下面划线完成对话。

ex.s: Read the Text Builder carefully.Then listen to the dialogue and complete it by underlining the words or expressions you hear.
ex.t: 仔细阅读文本构建器。然后听对话，在听到的单词或表达下面划线完成对话。

ex.s: Sometimes we lose sight that the music has a wider context,” says Moran, “so I want to continue those dialogues.
ex.t: “有时我们忽略了音乐有更广阔的语境，”莫兰说，“所以我想延续那些对话。”

ex.s: The curtains are about to open, and in a few minutes the action and dialogue will tell you the story.
ex.t: 幕布即将拉开，几分钟内的动作与对白将为你讲述这个故事。

defs.def: a formal discussion between two groups or countries, especially when they are trying to solve a problem, end a disagreement, etc. （尤指集体或国家间为解决问题、结束争端等进行的）对话

ex.s: Examples and dialogues are recorded with real native speakers instead of automatic computers.
ex.t: 例句和对话是由真正的母语者录制的，而不是用自动电脑生成的。

ex.s: Complete the dialogue between two new school friends about hobbies.Use the words andphrasesbelow.Some of them canbe used more than once.
ex.t: 完成两个新同学之间关于爱好的对话。使用下面的单词和短语。有些可以使用不止一次。
